title: Pope Francis message and Vatican paintings of orbs with angels

tellings.quote: and Pope Francis uh she said to tell me that they know that they're angels

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had many encounters with UFOs and glowing orbs, tells of a message he says came to him through Diana Pasulka, an academic. According to Bledsoe, she told him that Pope Francis wanted him to know that the Vatican, the headquarters of the Catholic Church, knows these beings are angels, a story he connects to Vatican paintings showing orbs with angels. If true, it would mean the Church sees these encounters as religious rather than alien.
